# DampScan

> Independent damp, mould and timber surveys across Kent and the South East,
> based in East Malling, Kent (ME19). DampScan is survey and report only: it
> carries out no damp proofing or other remedial work and takes no commission,
> so the report has nothing to sell.

DampScan surveys for homeowners, buyers, landlords and managing agents. The
core principle is diagnosis by somebody with no interest in the remedy: most
repeat damp problems are second visits to work that treated a symptom rather
than a cause.

## What happens

- Enquiries get a response the same day.
- The survey fee is published and fixed before the visit.
- The written report follows the day after the survey visit.
- Every survey includes calibrated moisture readings, an inspection inside and
  out, photographed evidence, the diagnosed cause and, where work is needed, a
  specification any contractor can price.
- There is no quote to follow and no follow-up chasing.

## Problems covered

Rising damp, penetrating damp, condensation and mould, timber decay, woodworm,
wet rot and dry rot, basement and cellar waterproofing, ventilation,
plaster and render, and independent damp surveys including pre-purchase
surveys and second opinions on invasive damp-proofing quotes.

## Second opinions

DampScan is regularly asked to review a quote for invasive damp-proofing from
another firm and will say plainly when that work is not justified.

## Areas

Kent, town by town: Maidstone, Sevenoaks, Tonbridge, Tunbridge Wells, the
Malling towns, the Medway towns, Gravesend, Dartford, Swanley, Edenbridge,
Sittingbourne, Faversham, Canterbury, Whitstable, Herne Bay, Thanet, Deal,
Dover, Folkestone, Hythe and Ashford, plus parts of Surrey and Sussex.
